# Prime collector whitespace

The pinned MathJax `Prime` handler uses `TexParser.GetNext`, which skips the JavaScript whitespace set. That set contains U+FEFF and excludes U+0085, unlike Go's `unicode.IsSpace`. Only the prime collector changes; shared row, argument and command whitespace policy is preserved.

`generate_prime_whitespace_collector.cjs` invokes the actual registered handler and original lookahead methods from the three hash-verified MathJax 3.2.2 assets. Its148 records exercise all25 source whitespace characters with both prime spellings and both ordinary/occupied-superscript bases, plus non-whitespace neighbors, an astral tail, EOF, mixed runs, scripts, commands, comments and group terminators. Together with the freshly reproduced original40 records, all188 compare token attributes/properties, original base identity, cursor, remaining source and rejection timing directly. The only removed private property is the separately asserted Go factory provenance marker, as in the original test.

`generate_prime_whitespace.cjs` reads `prime_whitespace_inputs.json` and uses fresh unmodified primary VMs. It records130 successful complete SVG/tree references and six primary runtime exceptions among136 inputs. All24 successful BOM-prime cases that differed before this change now have raw-primary SVG and explicit attributes;128 successful applicable cases compare whole SVGs. The124 named property qualifications retain only the established D060/D061 `pseudoscript` metadata difference at exact nodes/maps. They do not normalize SVG, attributes, token text or cursor policy.

The four no-prime controls retain their complete accepted-c499 Go trees and SVGs. BOM without a preceding prime has a preexisting mi/mo fallback difference with identical dimensions; the local collector fix does not change that route. The primary crashes for both repeated-prime and no-prime NEL controls and provides no output oracle. Its exact exception is retained; the Go path must remain deterministic and non-crashing, while registered collector state matches primary. Repeated-prime Go output changes when NEL is no longer collected as whitespace; this is recorded without calling it primary output parity.

Regenerate using normal Node with the pinned D2 `d2renderers/d2latex` asset directory. The public generator optionally writes the raw SVGs, projected trees and full compiler-tree observations to an evidence directory. Expected output is generated solely by the pinned primary.
